_doc: GARUDA-FILIERA per-ancestor RESTORE compiler spec (2026-07-18) — 49213 'Angkutan Perkotaan' graduates from detach (fase1_collisions.json, per_skala -> []) to RESTORE (per_skala <- the per-ancestor merged PP28 rows), per the signed conductor adjudication research/operations/2026-07-18-kbli-batch-a-plan.md §A-6(b)-RESOLVED (PR #2721/#2740). This file is scripts/kbli_filiera/cure_restore_per_ancestor.py's INPUT: it NEVER authors a new licensing value from plausibility (rule #9) — every per_skala row below is transcribed verbatim from an image-verified PP28 render (sha256 in adjudication.renders below), and the compiler is pure spec-driven write, never invents content. per_skala_disputed_pp28_collision (the OLD wrong-vintage AKDP-collision block) is left completely untouched by this restore — it stays as the historical audit trail. 49213 is REMOVED from fase1_collisions.json's codes list in this same PR (see that file's own _doc) so the generic detach compiler never re-quarantines the restored data.

Do NOT edit the served dataset by hand — data-plane guard #2550 blocks it; route changes through the compiler.
scope_note: 49219 'Angkutan Bus Dalam Trayek Lainnya' carries THREE territorial tiers in PP 28/2025 (row 11, p.I.I.51): antar-provinsi -> Menteri/Kepala Badan; dalam-provinsi -> Gubernur; kabupaten/kota -> Bupati/Wali Kota. Only the kabupaten/kota tier applies to 49213's intra-city scope (Angkutan Perkotaan); the other two tiers (inter-provincial, intra-provincial) describe route classes 49213 does not cover and are deliberately excluded from this restore's scope_index=1 rows.

data_note: KBLI 2025 code 49213 'Angkutan Perkotaan' (intra-city urban bus transport on a fixed trayek) had per_skala detached 2026-07-17 after a code-number collision was found: the old served per_skala carried KBLI-2020 code 49213 = 'Angkutan Bus Antarkota Dalam Provinsi (AKDP)' (inter-city, Gubernur authority), the wrong regulatory basis for an intra-city activity (preserved unchanged under per_skala_disputed_pp28_collision as a historical audit trail — never reused). Per-ancestor adjudication (research/operations/2026-07-18-kbli-batch-a-plan.md §A-6(b)-RESOLVED; conductor gate PR #2721/#2740) determined the correct regulatory basis for this intra-city scope is the MERGE of 3 PP 28/2025 Lampiran I.I rows whose regimes are substantially identical for the urban scope, each image-verified on the official BPK render (doc 394945): 49214 'Angkutan Bus Kota' (row 9, p.I.I.40-41), 49219 'Angkutan Bus Dalam Trayek Lainnya' (row 11, p.I.I.51 — ONLY its kabupaten/kota tier; the antar-provinsi/Menteri and dalam-provinsi/Gubernur tiers of 49219 do not apply to this intra-city scope and are excluded from the restore), and 49413 'Angkutan Perkotaan Bukan Bus, Dalam Trayek' (row 14, p.I.I.65-66). All 3 confirm the same regime for the urban scope: Ruang Lingkup Seluruh, Skala Usaha Mikro+Kecil+Menengah+Besar, Kategori Risiko Menengah Tinggi, Perizinan NIB dan Sertifikat Standar, Jangka Waktu 5 Hari, PB UMKU none, and municipal-level Kewenangan (Bupati/Wali Kota for 49214 and the used 49219 tier; Wali Kota for 49413). per_skala restored from these 3 per-ancestor rows (12 rows: 3 scopes x 4 skala tiers); persyaratan/kewajiban bullet text for these rows was not transcribed in this pass and is left empty pending a follow-up extraction, not fabricated here. The OLD per_skala_disputed_pp28_collision block is preserved verbatim and untouched by this restore.
